description: A commercial chemical process simulation suite. The Datacor page says CHEMCAD is a customisable process simulation suite for chemical engineering workflows, adaptable to many process scenarios, with rigorous process modelling, technical support from engineers and training, at a commercially competitive price, with demos on request; it is paid, licensed desktop software, not a free download. Coverage is chemical and process plants worldwide. Caveats: it is proprietary and the page read gives no licence or price. For simulation it models plant behaviour under changed feeds, utilities or equipment, for studies of chemical plant disruption and recovery. A related catalogue record is Aspen Plus.
